events.content: {"turn": 0, "summary": "Scene established: The Vale", "event": "The Vale, and its wells going quiet.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 1, "summary": "Sera says three days, and that the Fenwater went first.", "event": "Sera says three days, and that the Fenwater went first.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 2, "summary": "Bryn says the name people are avoiding: Maelor, in the Ashen Keep.", "event": "Bryn says the name people are avoiding: Maelor, in the Ashen Keep.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 3, "summary": "It tastes of cold iron. Corin spits it out.", "event": "It tastes of cold iron. Corin spits it out.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 4, "summary": "Nobody argues, which is worse than arguing.", "event": "Nobody argues, which is worse than arguing.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 5, "summary": "The square is full of people who have nowhere to draw water.", "event": "The square is full of people who have nowhere to draw water.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 6, "summary": "Half of them blame Maelor. Half blame the village council.", "event": "Half of them blame Maelor. Half blame the village council.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 7, "summary": "By noon Corin's shoulders are raw and the pails are still empty.", "event": "By noon Corin's shoulders are raw and the pails are still empty.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 8, "summary": "Grey stone, knitted shut, still warm.", "event": "Grey stone, knitted shut, still warm.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 9, "summary": "Bryn says his hammer would ring off it like a bell.", "event": "Bryn says his hammer would ring off it like a bell.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 10, "summary": "Wren says she will go ahead of him and break what he sets.", "event": "Wren says she will go ahead of him and break what he sets.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Wren", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go ahead of him and break what he sets.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}, {"speaker": "Sera", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go ahead of him and break what he sets.\"", "volume": "normal", "intended_target": null, "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": ""}, {"speaker": "Bryn", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go ahead of him and break what he sets.\"", "volume": "normal", "intended_target": null, "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": ""}]}
{"turn": 11, "summary": "Wren is gone before anyone thinks to thank her.", "event": "Wren is gone before anyone thinks to thank her.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 12, "summary": "Sera says she will go as far as the Old Road and come back.", "event": "Sera says she will go as far as the Old Road and come back.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Sera", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go as far as the Old Road.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}, {"speaker": "Bryn", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go as far as the Old Road.\"", "volume": "normal", "intended_target": null, "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": ""}]}
{"turn": 13, "summary": "The road runs between dead hedges.", "event": "The road runs between dead hedges.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 14, "summary": "Sera describes riders on the ridge, going east, in no hurry.", "event": "Sera describes riders on the ridge, going east, in no hurry.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 15, "summary": "It is running. Something broke the seal on it from above.", "event": "It is running. Something broke the seal on it from above.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 16, "summary": "The light goes out of the sky somewhere behind them.", "event": "The light goes out of the sky somewhere behind them.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 17, "summary": "Corin dreams of a well that answers when he calls into it.", "event": "Corin dreams of a well that answers when he calls into it.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 18, "summary": "Bryn says Siege Town, and that it has held out longer than it should.", "event": "Bryn says Siege Town, and that it has held out longer than it should.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 19, "summary": "Siege Town is standing, and that is the most that can be said.", "event": "Siege Town is standing, and that is the most that can be said.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 20, "summary": "They know a great deal, and most of it disagrees with itself.", "event": "They know a great deal, and most of it disagrees with itself.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 21, "summary": "Bryn tells the room about the well.", "event": "Bryn tells the room about the well.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 22, "summary": "Sera says there is a culvert, and that it is watched.", "event": "Sera says there is a culvert, and that it is watched.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Sera", "exact_quote": "\"There's a culvert. It's watched.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}, {"speaker": "Bryn", "exact_quote": "\"There's a culvert. It's watched.\"", "volume": "normal", "intended_target": null, "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": ""}]}
{"turn": 23, "summary": "Bryn says: obedience, and that he takes it one well at a time.", "event": "Bryn says: obedience, and that he takes it one well at a time.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 24, "summary": "The town goes quiet the way a held breath is quiet.", "event": "The town goes quiet the way a held breath is quiet.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 25, "summary": "It is fused shut. Nobody heard it happen.", "event": "It is fused shut. Nobody heard it happen.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 26, "summary": "Sera says she will go ahead. Bryn says he will hold the town.", "event": "Sera says she will go ahead. Bryn says he will hold the town.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Sera", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go ahead and watch the gate until dusk.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}, {"speaker": "Bryn", "exact_quote": "\"I'll go ahead and watch the gate until dusk.\"", "volume": "normal", "intended_target": null, "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": ""}]}

{"turn": 27, "summary": "Sera goes out through the culvert, and the town starts moving toward the gate behind her.", "event": "Sera goes out through the culvert, and the town starts moving toward the gate behind her.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 28, "summary": "The Citadel Gate is a slot in the rock, and it is cold.", "event": "The Citadel Gate is a slot in the rock, and it is cold.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 29, "summary": "No sign of her. The gate is watched by nobody Corin can see.", "event": "No sign of her. The gate is watched by nobody Corin can see.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 30, "summary": "There is a seam in the rock that was not there yesterday.", "event": "There is a seam in the rock that was not there yesterday.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 31, "summary": "Warm, and cracked across. Somebody got here first and did not finish.", "event": "Warm, and cracked across. Somebody got here first and did not finish.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 32, "summary": "The culvert Sera named runs under the gate.", "event": "The culvert Sera named runs under the gate.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 33, "summary": "It is a tight, wet, and entirely unwatched way in.", "event": "It is a tight, wet, and entirely unwatched way in.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 34, "summary": "The Ashen Keep is warm, and it is not empty.", "event": "The Ashen Keep is warm, and it is not empty.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 35, "summary": "The hall is long and there is a figure at the end of it.", "event": "The hall is long and there is a figure at the end of it.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 36, "summary": "Maelor answers without turning around.", "event": "Maelor answers without turning around.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 37, "summary": "He says water is the only thing nobody can refuse to need.", "event": "He says water is the only thing nobody can refuse to need.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Maelor", "exact_quote": "\"Water is the one thing nobody can refuse.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}]}
{"turn": 38, "summary": "He says the Vale has been kneeling for eleven days.", "event": "He says the Vale has been kneeling for eleven days.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 39, "summary": "He says he has not touched her, and Corin cannot tell if it is true.", "event": "He says he has not touched her, and Corin cannot tell if it is true.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Maelor", "exact_quote": "\"I have not touched your scout.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}]}
{"turn": 40, "summary": "It is a smith's apprentice's sword and it is not enough.", "event": "It is a smith's apprentice's sword and it is not enough.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 41, "summary": "Corin brings the hilt down on the warm seam. It rings.", "event": "Corin brings the hilt down on the warm seam. It rings.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 42, "summary": "The seal fails, and every sealed thing in the Vale fails with it.", "event": "The seal fails, and every sealed thing in the Vale fails with it.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 43, "summary": "Maelor is not frightened. He is recalculating.", "event": "Maelor is not frightened. He is recalculating.", "dialogue_log": [{"speaker": "Maelor", "exact_quote": "\"That was well done. It changes less than you think.\"", "volume": "normal", "tone": "", "visibility": "overt", "conceal_from": [], "articulation": "", "intended_target": null}]}
{"turn": 44, "summary": "He says he will not, and that he does not have to win quickly.", "event": "He says he will not, and that he does not have to win quickly.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 45, "summary": "He moves first.", "event": "He moves first.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 46, "summary": "It costs Corin his shield arm and buys him three feet.", "event": "It costs Corin his shield arm and buys him three feet.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 47, "summary": "It is quick, and afterwards the hall is very quiet.", "event": "It is quick, and afterwards the hall is very quiet.", "dialogue_log": []}
{"turn": 48, "summary": "Sera is at the gate, cold and furious and alive.", "event": "Sera is at the gate, cold and furious and alive.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 49, "summary": "The square is quieter, and the stalls stand stripped. Sera takes the stream path and does not see it.", "event": "The square is quieter, and the stalls stand stripped. Sera takes the stream path and does not see it.", "dialogue_log": []}

{"turn": 50, "summary": "The Fenwater is running, and the villagers' talk of the riders reaches Sera before Corin does.", "event": "The Fenwater is running, and the villagers' talk of the riders reaches Sera before Corin does.", "dialogue_log": []}
